timestamp_derivation: Computed from the workstation clock after the PRE-LIVE deployment and acceptance, and before the commit that introduces this receipt.
authorisation: The Product Owner extended the mission on 2026-10-26 to the Codex findings, the pmsd deployment and restart, and controlled authentication-only acceptance against two real Protel systems on PRE-LIVE. It does NOT authorise merging PR #252, PMS financial posting, Go-Live, or any change to physical networking.
findings: P2 token-scoped sources: a Mews connection without an enterprise id fingerprinted like every other on its platform, so source exclusivity would have refused the second independent property. A connection whose identity cannot name one property now gets a fingerprint no other connection can equal (RESTConfig.SourceIdentityComplete); Apaleo and OPERA Cloud require their property identity, so they are unchanged.

P2 source handoff: reconcile started replacement workers before stopping the old ones, so an interface republished from source X to Y while another took X could have two writers on X. Reconcile now plans first (planReconcile): every obsolete, revision-changed or displaced worker is stopped before any worker starts.

pmsd_restart: Preflight: no interface had undrained postings; the only posting ever made was POSTED and ACKED; counters pms_postings/outbox/payment_transactions 1/1/17. The restart reconnected the existing Protel link (150.0.0.18:5003) and resynchronised to IN_SYNC in about 37 s. After: the same interface id, the same published revision, 4142 stays, the same posting attempts, counters still 1/1/17.
acceptance: Second real Protel Interface 'Coral Sea Aqua Club' (120.0.0.15:5001, read-only, posting target UNSET) created, published and activated through the API: CONNECTED and IN_SYNC concurrently with the first (208 and 470 in-house stays). A draft revision pointing the Aqua interface at the Protel endpoint was refused at publish with 409 pms_source_in_use and changed nothing (the draft is retained unpublished as revision 2). On the live Client Wi-Fi network, each with a free package and a fresh client on the guest bridge: DEDICATED Protel - Protel stay VERIFIED and online, Aqua stay refused (STAY_NOT_ELIGIBLE); DEDICATED Aqua - Aqua stay VERIFIED and online, Protel stay refused (ROOM_NOT_IN_MIRROR); SHARED_STRICT Protel+Aqua - single-room stays from both hotels VERIFIED and online, and a room number in house at both hotels VERIFIED for each guest by their own verification; SHARED_STRICT with Aqua switched off - the Protel stay refused (ROUTING_OR_INTERFACE_FAILURE), failing closed. Seven sessions granted, each ended and its entitlement terminated; no leftover sessions or namespaces; financial counters unchanged at 1/1/17. The network's routing was restored to DEDICATED Protel and verified identical. Aqua was left AUTH_DISABLED (published, inert, holds no PMS slot).
verification: Before: pmsd, pmsprovider and pmsresolve suites, the edged integration suite on a fresh full schema, new tests for token-scoped Mews sources, for the handoff plan (the old owner is stopped first, a running owner is not displaced) and for SourceIdentityComplete. After deployment: units active, DEPLOYED_BINARIES 7 of 7, APPLIANCE_UNITS PASS. NOT performed: any PMS posting, purchase or reversal; a stale-roster scenario on a real disconnected PMS; physical-network delivery of tagged VLANs; the Aqua network itself (disabled by the Product Owner).
rollback: edged.bak-pre-735efe77-20261026T055200Z, pmsd.bak-pre-735efe77-20261026T055225Z; hotel-admin.previous -> 20261026-010341. No schema to roll back.
follow_up: OPEN: the Product Owner's head-specific approval to merge PR #252. The Aqua Protel interface exists AUTH_DISABLED; activating it and mapping it to a network is the Product Owner's choice. The runtime row of a disabled interface keeps its last transport state until it is next activated.
